name: io.citemark/citemark
title: Citemark
description: Check if ChatGPT and Claude recommend your product, who they name instead and the pages they cite.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Checks whether ChatGPT and Claude recommend a product when people ask which tool to use. It reads the product's homepage, writes 5 questions a buyer in its category would ask, asks each AI, and reports how often the product is named and in what position, which competitors are named instead, which websites the answers cite, three suggested fixes, and a link to the full shareable report. Takes about a minute. A site checked in the last 7 days returns that report instead of asking again.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

category.description: Optional: what kind of product it is, like 'uptime monitoring tool'. Read from the homepage when left out.

tools.name: get_ai_picks
tools.description: Returns the products ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude recommend most in a software category, ranked by how often they are named across a fixed set of buyer questions that Citemark asks every two weeks, with each product's share of answers and average position.

category.description: The software category: screenshot-apis (Screenshot APIs), transactional-email (Transactional email services), product-analytics (Product analytics tools), privacy-friendly-analytics (Privacy-friendly web analytics), uptime-monitoring (Uptime monitoring tools), error-tracking (Error tracking tools), feature-flags (Feature flag tools), form-builders (Online form builders), newsletter-platforms (Newsletter platforms), ai-coding-assistants (AI coding assistants).

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Reads a website's robots.txt and reports which of 15 AI crawlers (from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Apple, Meta and others) may crawl its homepage, separating bots that fetch pages for AI answers from bots that collect training data, plus the robots.txt lines that would let blocked answer bots in.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

tools.name: start_tracking
tools.description: Starts tracking a website in the user's Citemark account: sets up the questions buyers ask AI about its category and the competitors to compare it with, then asks AI assistants those questions on the account's schedule and shows the results on the Citemark dashboard. Needs the user's Citemark account; Claude asks them to connect it the first time. Does nothing if the website is already tracked.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

category.description: Optional: what kind of product it is, like 'uptime monitoring tool'. Read from the homepage when left out.

tools.name: get_my_tracking
tools.description: Summarizes the websites the user tracks in their Citemark account: for each, how often AI assistants named it in the last 7 days, the competitor named most, and a link to its dashboard. Needs the user's Citemark account.

website.description: Optional: only this tracked website, like acme.com.
